verdict: NOT converged — 2 of 3 criteria met. (1) Blocking = 0: met (round 1 was also 0; every round-2 prosecutor count was adjudicated in the merge and the sims raised no design-blocking finding). (2) Surface not grown: met — 2 identity concepts / 1 new verb (restore) / 1 new flag (--force), byte-identical to the round-1 spend; the v3 folds add 0 verbs, 0 flags, 0 concepts, 0 grammar changes, 0 dependencies. (3) Novel friction = 0: MISSED — honest count is 2, down from 9: (a) the durability/journal equivalence was argued only for power loss and 'advisory' was unscoped (skeptic P2) — folded into v3 as ordering-derived, interruption-agnostic wording with the advisory lock scoped and foreign-edit corruption declared loud, zero surface; (b) the thrice-stated 'writes only inside the store' read as overcompensating to one skeptic with zero task impact — adjudicated and retained on the stronger round-1 cold-user evidence (not a concrete defect against the decided item). Honesty caveat: 2 of 4 sims executed the shipped v1.0.13 binary instead of the documented design; their failures measure version skew (the ledgered deliberate pre-freeze breaking changes seen from the wrong side) and were discounted — the doc-only personas went 12/12 with zero-to-cosmetic friction. Verdict: one doc-only (or prototype-backed) confirmation round on v3 is required before freeze; both v3 deltas are clarifying sentences with no semantics or surface change, so round 3 is expected to measure 0.

summary: v2.5 → v3 is a pure wording fold: no mechanism, semantics, grammar, flag, verb, or concept changed. (1) Folded the skeptic's P2 friction — the print-barrier/journal equivalence is now stated as a consequence of write ordering alone, so any interruption (killed process, kernel panic, power loss) is one case; stated in id(1) DURABILITY, log(1) JOURNAL ENTRY, restore(1) DURABILITY, design §3, verdict shape, and T4 closure. 'Advisory' is scoped: the lock binds c4's own writers, which are the only sanctioned writers inside a store; a foreign edit to store files is corruption, and corruption cannot be silent — every read is rehash-verified and every journal line is a claim recomputable in one pipe. (2) Lock naming aligned across man pages: gc(1) now names the sweep lock (with a pointer to the separate append lock in log(1)), eliminating the 'store lock'/'append lock' drift. (3) Adjudicated-retained: the deliberate 'writes only inside the store' repetition stands on round-1 cold-user evidence; consolidation deferred to round 3 only if re-raised by doc-only sims. (4) Discounted accepted-tradeoff repeats: named-refs undo burden; fsync-primitive trust (platform-honesty tradeoff, falsifiability recipe already on the surface). (5) Voided the two harness-contaminated sims (executed shipped v1.0.13 against the design docs) with a ledger entry recording the weighting decision; harness fix is an open item. Ledger: 5 reasons amended for auditability, 2 entries added (interruption-agnostic wording; sim evidence weighting); nothing reopened, reversed, or re-litigated; all accepted tradeoffs stand.
